result.title: LiveGeo: Benchmarking Geographic Agents in Continuously Evolving Worlds
result.summary: We introduce GeoWorld, a controllable and continuously evolving geographic environment platform for LLM agents, and LiveGeo, a benchmark for evaluating reliable decision-making in real-world geographic environments using GeoWorld. Unlike existing evaluations that largely reason and plan over fixed geographic states, GeoWorld is grounded in real-world geographic structure and allows external world states to evolve along their own temporal processes while preserving verifiable state histories. LiveGeo places geographic tasks within this evolving environment, requiring agents to actively acquire task-relevant information, verify whether the evidence supporting prior decisions remains valid, and revise their plans when necessary. Our results reveal that even frontier LLMs struggle with static tasks, with no model consistently excelling across tasks, while strong static performance does not ensure dynamic reliability. Further analysis identifies a key bottleneck: agents struggle to acquire and translate relevant evidence into valid decisions and maintain their correctness as the world evolves. By releasing LiveGeo together with its GeoWorld platform, we aim to provide the community with a flexible and extensible infrastructure for studying the next generation of agents capable of reliable action in evolving geographic worlds.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文构建 GeoWorld——一个可控制、状态随时间自行演化且保留可验证状态历史的地理环境平台，并据此提出 LiveGeo 基准，评测 LLM agent 主动获取任务相关信息、检验既有决策所依赖证据是否仍有效并在必要时修正计划；结果显示静态任务表现好并不保证动态环境下的可靠性。
AI.relevance_reason: 「证据是否仍支撑先前决策、何时重新取信息」与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选及 LOOK/STOP 的停止与重取决策问题形式相近，可供核查其证据时效性评价设计；但该环境非视觉、无 latent 状态，联系仍属概念层。
